# Una Collective

> Una Collective is a DEIB (Diversity, Equity, Inclusion & Belonging) consultancy firm delivering data-driven assessments, strategic consulting, and leadership development to drive organizational transformation.

Based in the Netherlands, Una Collective combines research-backed methodologies with hands-on consulting to help organizations build inclusive cultures. Their services span assessment tools, bespoke consultancy, masterclasses, and thought leadership publications.

## Key Topics

- DEIB (Diversity, Equity, Inclusion & Belonging)
- Organizational Transformation
- Inclusive Leadership
- Data-Driven Assessment
- Culture Pulse
- Leadership Pulse
- DEIB Consultancy
- Belonging
- Organizational Change
- Gender Equality Impact (SDG5)
- Reduced Inequalities (SDG10)
- Great Resignation
- Great Reshuffle

## Core Services

- [DEIB Assessment](https://www.unacollective.com/assessment): Data-driven DEIB assessment products for organizational culture evaluation.
- [DEIB Consultancy](https://www.unacollective.com/deibconsultancy): Bespoke DEIB consultancy services for organizational transformation.
- [Masterclasses](https://www.unacollective.com/komkommertijd-masterclasses): Masterclass series on inclusive leadership and team development.
